# Document types

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_catalog.py. Do not edit. -->

DRS has 105 document types. External API keys can read 79. The other 26 are internal only.

Use the `DocType` member or the code string. Get the fields of a type with `catalog.get_doctype(code).fields`.

**Text** shows that the API returns the full document text in the metadata.
